items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I joined the John Kirby band... Charlie Shavers had heard me play... So Charler Shavers and Kirby called me to come down and replace Buster Bailey.

ctx.x: I want to ask you this -- about Russell Procope, another New Yorker.

Russell Procope has always been one of the strongest and one of the best readers, saxophone players that I ever met. My first close, close experience was -- with him was when I joined the John Kirby band. I became the seventh man in the John Kirby band, and that was because Buster Bailey and Kirby had had an argument. So Charlie Shavers had heard me play Jelly, Jelly on clarinet -- on the record with Earl Hines, and he says, well, man, you better call Budd Johnson. So Charler Shavers and Kirby called me to come…

Well, I said, okay. So I had the presence of mind to take my tenor with me also, and then on my way down on the train, I got to thinking, I said, I must be out of my mind to think I'm going to take a clarinet and follow Buster Bailey in the John Kirby band.
